module autovcoder_124491 (  
    input clk,  
    input rst,  
    input [1:0] input_bits,  
    input [1:0] state,  
    output reg [1:0] decoded_bits  
);  
    reg [1:0] next_state;  
    reg [1:0] metric;  
   
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin  
        if (rst) begin  
            decoded_bits <= 2'b00;  
            next_state <= 2'b00;  
            metric <= 2'b00;  
        end else begin  
            // Example transition logic; this should be based on your specific Viterbi implementation  
            case (state)  
                2'b00: begin  
                    if (input_bits == 2'b00) begin  
                        next_state <= 2'b00;  
                        metric <= 2'b00;  
                    end else begin  
                        next_state <= 2'b01;  
                        metric <= 2'b01;  
                    end  
                end  
                2'b01: begin  
                    if (input_bits == 2'b01) begin  
                        next_state <= 2'b10;  
                        metric <= 2'b10;  
                    end else begin  
                        next_state <= 2'b00;  
                        metric <= 2'b11;  
                    end  
                end  
                // More states and transitions  
                default: begin  
                    next_state <= 2'b00;  
                    metric <= 2'b00;  
                end  
            endcase  
            decoded_bits <= metric;  
        end  
    end  
endmodule
